Print a survey_pooled_pvals object

Source: R/pool-pvals.R
print.survey_pooled_pvals.Rd

Prints a one-line cli header summarizing the adjustment method, family size, and number of significant rows; delegates the body to tibble's print method via NextMethod(); and prints a one-line footer when any p-values were excluded as NA.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'survey_pooled_pvals'
print(x, n = 10, ...)

Arguments

x

A survey_pooled_pvals object.

n

Integer(1). Maximum number of rows to print. Passed through to print.tbl_df. Default 10.

...

Additional arguments passed to print.tbl_df.

Value

invisible(x).

See also

Other multiplicity correction: pool_pvals()

Examples

res <- list(
  a = tibble::tibble(p_value = c(0.01, 0.04)),
  b = tibble::tibble(p_value = 0.5)
)
out <- pool_pvals(res)
print(out)
#> <survey_pooled_pvals: method = "BH", family_size = 3, 1 significant at alpha =
#> 0.05>
#> # A tibble: 3 × 3
#>   p_value source p_value_adj
#>     <dbl> <chr>        <dbl>
#> 1    0.01 a             0.03
#> 2    0.04 a             0.06
#> 3    0.5  b             0.5
